LESSON: EXPLORING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.1 Weather and Sky By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners to 
Topic 2.2.2: Exploring

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Exploring. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How is the weather today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify weather conditions of the day
2. make reasonable weather forecast of the day
3. appreciate weather conditions at different times of the day. weather conditions of a day using age appropriate stimulus materials conditions for enjoyment 63 the sky during the day and at night from parents or guardians. picture on weather.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify weather conditions of the day

2. make reasonable weather forecast of the day

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Exploring.
2. Explain Exploring to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Exploring.
4. Show that you can: identify weather conditions of the day
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Exploring. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How is the weather today?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify weather conditions of the day
2. make reasonable weather forecast of the day
3. appreciate weather conditions at different times of the day. weather conditions of a day using age appropriate stimulus materials conditions for enjoyment 63 the sky during the day and at night from parents or guardians. picture on weather.
